content: Ainor ham ne naki biššaš
O bekub Galatiyo okkol! Tũwarare zadu hone goijje? Isa Mosire kurušot diyore marifela oilde hiyan ki tũwarar sukor sarme kulasa gori howa no o ne?
Ãi tũwarattu iyan zainto sair: Tũwara Pak Ruhure ki ainor ham goronor duwara faiyode ne naki ze kušir hóbor fuinno edde biššaš goijjo hinor duwara?
Tũwara eto bekub ka? Tũwara Ruh loi noya zibon šuru goriyore, ehon gar issa mozin šeš goitto sodde neki?
Edun duk hošto zin tũwara búg goijjo in ki hannasun ne? Asole hiyan zodi hannasun oito!
Tũwarare zibaye Ruh de edde tũwarar butore keramoti ham okkol gore, hibaye hin ainor ham goronor zoriya ne, naki kušir hóbor fuinno edde biššaš goijjode hetolla gore de?
Bafi so, Ibrahime "Allare biššaš goijjil, ar hetolla Allaye hibare forhesgar hisabe goissil."
Hetolla tũwara iyan zani rako, hitara zarattu biššaš ase hitara oilde Ibrahimor fuwain.

Pak kitabot agam hóbor hisabe leikka ase, Allaye Oihudi okkolore biššašor duwara forhesgar hisabe gosibo. Bout agottu loti ei kušir hóboror babute Ibrahimore zanai diya oil, "Hár zati okkolore tor duwara rahamot gora oibo."
Hetolla hitara zara biššaši, he biššaši Ibrahimor fũwati hitara o rahamoti.

Kiyollahoile hitara zara ainor uwore boroša gore hitara oilde gozobor tole, kiyollahoile iyan endilla leka ase: "Hár kissu zin ain kitabot leka ase hin beggun ze falon no gore, hitara fotti ekzon gozobor tole."
Iyan foriškar ze, ze hono kiye ainor uwore boroša gore, hite Allar sarme forhesgar no oibo, kiyollahoile, "Forhesgar okkol biššaš loi zibon haṛaibo."
Biššaš loi Torar ain loi hono baza nai, bolke endilla leka ase, "Ainor hár kissu mozin ze sole, hite hin loi basibo."
Mosiye ãrar gozob hibar uwore loiyore hiba nize gozoippa oiyore ãrare ainor gozobottu azad goijje, kiyollahoile iyan endilla leka ase, "Ze hono kiyore gasor uwore loṭka o, hite gozoippa."
Hibaye ãrare azad goijje, toi zene ze rahamot Ibrahimore diya oil hiyan Mosi Isar duwara Oihudi okkolor hãse fõsi fare, toi zene ãra biššašor duwara wada gora Pak Ruhure gosi fari.
Torar ain edde wada
Báiboinain okkol, ãi tũwarare amfam ekkan mesal diyore buzai. Duizon manuše zẽtte razi oiyore ekkan wadar sukti gore, hiyan honokiye bangi no fare, ar hiyanot kissu zug o gori no fare.
He bafe Allaye Ibrahimore edde hibar bongšore wada diye. Pak kitabot "bongšo okkolore," mani manuš okkol boli no ho, bolke "tor bongšore," mani ekzon, hiba oilde Mosi.
Ãi hoidde hiyan oilde endilla: Ze Torar ain 430 bosor bade aišše hiyane Allar foilar wadar suktire batil gori no fare.
Allar hadiya zodi ainor duwara diya oito, toile hiyan ar hono wadar duwara no; kintu Allaye hibar doyar butore Ibrahimore he hadiya wadar duwara dan goijje.
Toile Torar ain kiyolla dilo? Iyan zug gora oiyede naformanire sinibolla edde he wada gora bongšo nu aiye foijjonto hiyan zari take. Ei ain firista okkolor duwara mazottu ekzonor duwara diya oil.
Zeṛe ekzon heṛe hono mazottu ekzon no lage, ar Allah oilde ek.
Torar ain ki toile Allar wadar ulda? Ebbere o no! Kiyollahoile Allaye zodi endilla ekkan ain dito ziyane akerotor zibon de, toile hameka ainor duwara forhesgar oi faitto.
Kintu pak kitabe ho, manuš beggun gunar tole bondi ase, zene zara Isa Mosir uwore biššas gore hitara hitarar biššašor duwara wada gora hadiya fa.
Allar fuwain
Biššaš aibar age Torar aine ãrare fahara dil, he biššaš forhaš no o foijjonto ãrare bondi gori raikkil.
Hetolla Mosi nu aiye foijjonto ain ãrar ustad aiššil, zene ãrare biššašor duwara forhesgar hisabe gosa o.
Kintu ehon zehon Mosir uwore biššaš goribar babute kušir hóbor aigiyegoi, ar ãra ainor odínot nai.
Tũwara beggune Mosi Isar uwore biššaš goronor duwara Allar fuwain oiyo.
Kiyollahoile tũwara zarare Mosir butore torikotor gusol diya oiye, tũwara Mosire hor fĩdofan fĩdifelayo.
Toi hetolla Ihudi edde Oihudir maze, gulam edde azad mainšor maze, mayafuwain ar morod fuwaindor maze, hono forok nai, kiyollahoile tũwara Mosi Isat beggun ek.
Tũwara zodi Mosir o, toile wada mozin tũwara Ibrahimor bongšo edde mirasdar.
